help.title: Help
help.start.title: What Studio is
help.start.body: Studio is the home screen for the eight CadCraft apps. It opens each app, keeps your recent files from all of them in one place, and opens any file in the app that reads it. It is not a ninth app: every app works on its own too.
help.open.title: Opening files
help.open.body: Choose Open a file or drop files on Studio. Drawings go to CadCraft, models to BimCraft and the rest to the app that reads them. A PDF can be reviewed in MarkupCraft or measured in TakeoffCraft, so Studio asks, and can remember your answer (Settings, Opening files).
help.recent.title: Recent files
help.recent.body: Every file you open or save in any app is listed here, newest first. Click one to open it in the app it came from. In a browser, only browsers that remember files (Chrome and Edge) can reopen them by themselves.
help.windows.title: Windows
help.windows.body: Each file opens in its own window, so you can have several drawings open side by side. The Studio button in every app's bar brings you back here.
help.account.title: Your account and cloud drawings
help.account.body: Sign in once and every app can open and save your cloud drawings. Studio shows a short code; approve it on getcadcraft.com/device. When you are offline, saves wait on this computer and send when the connection returns; a save never overwrites a newer version.
help.assistants.title: Connecting an assistant
help.assistants.body: An AI assistant can work in your drawings through Studio (desktop). Open an app, turn on Settings › Assistants there and choose what it may do. The Connect an assistant card then shows an address that works only on this computer, a token, and the settings to paste into your assistant. Keep the token private. New token signs every assistant out; Disconnect all ends their sessions.
help.offline.title: Working offline
help.offline.body: Studio and the apps run on your own computer. Nothing you open is uploaded unless you save it to the cloud.

help.live.title: Working together live
help.live.body: Open a file in any app and choose Live in its bar, then Share live. People on the same network join with the code Studio shows (or by scanning the picture); for anyone elsewhere, make an invite link. You approve each person, as Edit or View only. Everyone sees changes as they happen, and your own changes never wait for others. Undo undoes only your own work. Only the host saves the file; when the session ends, everyone else keeps an unsaved copy. Sessions on your own network are free; invite links over the internet need a commercial license for the app, and guests need nothing. To join, use Join a live session here.
